the_seam_is_the_product_of_the_two_ends.detail: sqrt5 * sqrt-3 = sqrt-15 -- the seam field sits inside the compositum by construction

fundamental_discriminants_5_and_minus_3_.detail: disc Q(sqrt5)=5, disc Q(sqrt-3)=-3, product=-15 = disc Q(sqrt-15)=-15

genus_field_degree_matches_the_class_num.detail: 2^(t-1) = 2 with t=2 prime discriminants; h = 2. Equal => the GENUS field IS the HILBERT class field (the class group is elementary 2-group)

the_compositum_is_degree_4_over_Q_hence_.detail: Q(sqrt5, sqrt-3) has degree 4 over Q, so degree 2 over Q(sqrt-15) -- matching h = 2

the_seam_field_is_a_subfield_of_the_comp.detail: and it is the fixed field of the automorphism negating BOTH radicals

verdict.statement: HCF(Q(sqrt-15)) = Q(sqrt5, sqrt-3) = the compositum of the two ends
